nodes.description: Owner address of the presale contract; receives ETH/USDT and is checked by onlyOwner.
Public presale amount set to 3000000 ether.
Kyber swap proxy used to quote ETH/USDT expected rate.
ERC20 STRONG token distributed to buyers.
Constant pseudo address representing ETH in Kyber quotes.
Constant USDT ERC20 token address used for transferFrom payments.
Rate tiers array used to convert USDT into STRONG.
Mapping of seller address to accumulated sold amount, used for bonus tiers.
Constructor that sets owner to msg.sender.
Modifier restricting callers to the owner.
Returns the tiered USDT->STRONG rate based on the USDT amount.
Converts a USDT amount into a STRONG amount using getRate.
Queries the Kyber proxy for the ETH->USDT expected rate.
Converts an ETH amount into a STRONG amount via ETH2USDT and USDT2Strong.
Payable deposit: forwards ETH to owner and sends STRONG to msg.sender.
Pulls USDT from msg.sender to owner and sends STRONG to msg.sender.
ETH deposit that also pays a bonus to a third-party seller.
USDT deposit that also pays a bonus to a third-party seller.
Owner-only withdrawal of remaining STRONG tokens.
Returns this contract's STRONG balance.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, transfers and seller checks.
Block timestamp; not referenced by this contract.
Original transaction sender; not referenced by this contract.
owner.transfer(msg.value) sends ETH to owner within depositEth.
STRONG.transfer(msg.sender, amountStrong) in depositEth.
USDT_TOKEN_ADDRESS.transferFrom(msg.sender, owner, _amountUsdt) in depositUSDT.
STRONG.transfer(msg.sender, amountStrong) in depositUSDT.
STRONG.transfer(_seller, bonusAmount) with attacker-chosen recipient in depositEthWithSeller.
sellers[_seller] += amountStrong state update in depositEthWithSeller.
STRONG.transfer(_seller, bonusAmount) with attacker-chosen recipient in depositUSDTWithSeller.
sellers[_seller] += amountStrong state update in depositUSDTWithSeller.
STRONG.transfer(_address, tokenBalanceOfContract) in withdraw.
External call to proxyKyberSwap.getExpectedRate in ETH2USDT.
_usdtAmount.mul(1000).div(rate) arithmetic in USDT2Strong.
amountStrong.mul(bonusPercent).div(1000) bonus arithmetic in depositEthWithSeller.
amountStrong.mul(bonusPercent).div(1000) bonus arithmetic in depositUSDTWithSeller.

edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier guards withdraw so only the owner can drain the remaining STRONG.
USDT2Strong calls getRate to obtain the tiered rate.
ETH2STRONG calls ETH2USDT for the ETH to USDT quote.
ETH2STRONG calls USDT2Strong to finish the conversion.
depositEthWithSeller reuses depositEth for the base deposit.
depositUSDTWithSeller reuses depositUSDT for the base deposit.
withdraw calls getRemainingToken to size the transfer.
depositEth calls ETH2STRONG to compute the STRONG amount.
depositUSDT calls USDT2Strong to compute the STRONG amount.
depositEthWithSeller calls ETH2STRONG again for the bonus base.
depositUSDTWithSeller calls USDT2Strong again for the bonus base.
depositEth performs owner.transfer(msg.value).
depositEth performs an external STRONG.transfer to msg.sender.
depositUSDT performs an external USDT transferFrom.
depositUSDT performs an external STRONG.transfer to msg.sender.
depositEthWithSeller transfers bonus STRONG to an arbitrary seller.
depositEthWithSeller updates sellers[_seller] after external calls.
depositEthWithSeller computes bonus via mul/div with attacker-influenced values.
depositUSDTWithSeller transfers bonus STRONG to an arbitrary seller.
depositUSDTWithSeller updates sellers[_seller] after external calls.
depositUSDTWithSeller computes bonus via mul/div with attacker-influenced values.
withdraw performs STRONG.transfer to the destination address.
ETH2USDT performs an external call to the Kyber proxy.
USDT2Strong performs mul/div arithmetic on user-supplied amounts.
Constructor writes msg.sender into owner, making ownership caller-dependent.
msg.sender is the recipient of STRONG in depositEth.
msg.sender is the recipient of STRONG in depositUSDT.
msg.sender is the from-address of the USDT transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared to owner inside the onlyOwner guarded withdraw.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable for the authorization check.
owner is the recipient of msg.value via owner.transfer.
getRate indexes the rates array to pick a tier.
sellers mapping is read then incremented in depositEthWithSeller.
sellers mapping is read then incremented in depositUSDTWithSeller.
STRONG token is transferred out in depositEth.
STRONG token is transferred out in depositUSDT.
STRONG token is transferred out as a seller bonus in depositEthWithSeller.
STRONG token is transferred out as a seller bonus in depositUSDTWithSeller.
STRONG token is transferred out in withdraw.
USDT_TOKEN_ADDRESS is the token pulled by transferFrom.
proxyKyberSwap is the target of the getExpectedRate external call.
_usdtAmount parameter selects the rate tier in getRate.
_usdtAmount parameter feeds the conversion arithmetic in USDT2Strong.
_amountStrong return value is produced by mul/div arithmetic.
expectedRate local receives the Kyber quote in ETH2USDT.
_amountUsdt return value carries the external quote out of ETH2USDT.
_amountETH parameter drives the ETH to STRONG conversion.
amountStrong local is the transferred amount in depositEth.
_amountUsdt parameter controls the USDT pulled in depositUSDT.
_seller parameter selects the bonus recipient in depositEthWithSeller.
bonusAmount local, derived from mul/div, is the amount sent to the seller.
_seller parameter selects the bonus recipient in depositUSDTWithSeller.
bonusAmount local, derived from mul/div, is the amount sent to the seller.
_address parameter is the destination of the owner-only withdrawal.
tokenBalanceOfContract local is the amount transferred in withdraw.
Native ETH transfer to owner can trigger a fallback that reenters depositEth before state settles.
External call into the Kyber proxy can call back into ETH2USDT-dependent flows.
ERC20 transfer to an arbitrary seller can invoke a malicious token hook that reenters depositEthWithSeller.
ERC20 transfer to an arbitrary seller can invoke a malicious token hook that reenters depositUSDTWithSeller.
STRONG transfer in withdraw can call back into the contract before completion.
USDT transferFrom executes token code that may reenter depositUSDT.

Parameter _seller only feeds depositEthWithSeller and should be folded into it.
Local selledAmout only feeds the bonus tier logic of depositEthWithSeller.
Local bonusPercent only feeds the bonus tier logic of depositEthWithSeller.
Local amountStrong is the base for the seller bonus transfer in depositEthWithSeller.
Local bonusAmount is exactly the value transferred to the seller.
Parameter _seller only feeds depositUSDTWithSeller and should be folded into it.
Local selledAmout only feeds the bonus tier logic of depositUSDTWithSeller.
Local bonusPercent only feeds the bonus tier logic of depositUSDTWithSeller.
Local amountStrong is the base for the seller bonus transfer in depositUSDTWithSeller.
Local bonusAmount is exactly the value transferred to the seller.

Local tokenBalanceOfContract is exactly the amount transferred in withdraw.
